assistant.description: One assistant for nutrition, cooking and training. Your key is saved in your settings of all three apps.
assistant.envLocked: The server's environment configures the assistant; requests go through NutriTrace.
assistant.baseUrlHint: Ollama, LM Studio, LocalAI and others with a /v1/chat/completions endpoint. It must allow this site to call it (CORS).
assistant.reliability: Small local models often use tools unreliably.
assistant.keyOptional: Only if the endpoint asks for one.
assistant.name: Assistant's name
assistant.smartLogHint: Hold the assistant button and say what you ate, cooked or trained. In nutrition and training you check it before it is saved.
assistant.goalInsightsHint: The assistant points out how you're doing against your goals.
assistant.cookLocked: CookTrace's environment fixes the AI for its imports and label scan: {{setup}}

triggers.title: Trigger words
triggers.meal: "my X meal" takes a saved meal
triggers.recipe: "my X recipe" takes a saved recipe
triggers.yesterday: "same as yesterday for lunch" copies yesterday's items
